definitions.explanation: A wall built from precast concrete blocks, commonly used around houses and properties in Japan. Frequently discussed as an earthquake hazard because poorly reinforced walls can collapse.

examples.japanese: {家|いえ}の{周|まわ}りはブロック{塀|べい}だ。
examples.english: The house is surrounded by a concrete block wall.

examples.japanese: {古|ふる}いブロック{塀|べい}が{倒|たお}れる{危険|きけん}がある。
examples.english: There is a risk that the old block wall will collapse.

examples.japanese: {地震|じしん}で{倒壊|とうかい}したブロック{塀|べい}に{巻|ま}き{込|こ}まれる{事故|じこ}が{各地|かくち}で{発生|はっせい}した。
examples.english: Accidents involving collapsed block walls during the earthquake occurred in various places.

notes:
Compound of ブロック (block) + {塀|べい} (wall, fence). Very common around Japanese residential properties.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ブロック{塀|べい}を{建|た}てる: build a block wall
- ブロック{塀|べい}が{倒|たお}れる: a block wall falls over
- ブロック{塀|べい}の{倒壊|とうかい}: collapse of a block wall
- {古|ふる}いブロック{塀|べい}: old block wall

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {石塀|いしべい}: stone wall — built with stones rather than concrete blocks
- {壁|かべ}: wall — interior or structural wall of a building
- フェンス: fence — metal or wire fencing, not solid
